About me

Sawasdee ka! I'm the real person behind every tip.

Phuket is my home. I know which beaches stay quiet at sunset, which noodle stall the taxi drivers eat at, and which “famous” tours you can skip.

As a licensed guide I see visitors pay too much for the wrong things every day. So I wrote everything down: the places, the prices and the little tricks. Now you can explore Phuket like a friend showed you around.

🧭

Private guiding

A day with me, planned around what you love: food, temples, nature or all three.

🚤

Private boat & islands

Island hopping on your own boat, at a fair local price, timed to skip the crowds.

✈️

Airport pickup

A friendly face and a fixed price when you land. No taxi haggling at midnight.

Trusted local rentals with honest deposits. I'll tell you what to check first.

Questions

Good to know

Is Sukanya a real person?

Yes! I'm a licensed Tourism Authority of Thailand guide living in Phuket. My licence is shown above, and you can message me any time on Facebook, Instagram or by email.

How do I get the eBook after paying?

You'll get a download link by email right after payment. It works on phone, tablet and computer.

Is the information up to date?

I update the eBook regularly. Buyers get every new version for free.

What is the Explorer map?

It's a coming-soon digital map. You check in at real places when you're physically there and collect badges and rewards in your Stellar wallet. eBook buyers get early access.
